lt.line: Nukritusi į gerą žemę sėkla – tai tie, kurie klauso žodžio, išsaugo jį geroje širdyje ir duoda vaisių kantrumu“.

en.event: Saturday of the Twenty-fourth Week in Ordinary Time
en.line: But as for the seed that fell on rich soil, they are the ones who, when they have heard the word, embrace it with a generous and good heart, and bear fruit through perseverance.
